of appetite and \u0026nbsp;vomiting since 2 months\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPedal edema since 1 year\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo c\/o Shortness of breath, decreased urine output, burning micturition.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient was apparently asymptomatic 1 year ago then she developed pedal edema, on and off, \u0026nbsp;upto mid calf level ,which relieved on walking.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EC\/o facial puffiness on and off since 1 year\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe pt went to a hospital in Nalgonda for the same where her Sr.creat was 11.0\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe pt was advised for dialysis I\/v\/o high serum creatinine but they were not willing to get it done and so was started on medication after which her serum creatinine came down to 7.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe pt has been using the same medication since the past one year with which she was comfortable \u0026nbsp;as her complaints subsided and was leading a normal life.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESince 2 months \u0026nbsp;ago she developed loss of appetite and vomiting for which she went to a private hospital.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EShe was referred to KIMS, NKP for dialysis I\/v\/o high serum creatinine.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr
